typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech. Radical weight contrast, engineered and precise.

fonts.body: Manrope, sans-serif (Clean, readable at small sizes)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For stats, numbers, labels, datestamps)

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Cyber/Tech

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle CSS noise overlays (mix-blend-overlay with low opacity) on dark sections to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have 1px borders. NO soft shadows. Flat solid surfaces with sharp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky header: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp corners or very minimal radius (rounded-sm). No pill-shaped cards.

layouts.grid_strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol (High Density/Tetris mix).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: py-24 to py-32 for sections. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
layouts.alignment: Strict grid hierarchy. Left-align text for serious, technical feel. Use optical alignment.

motion.hero_animation: Signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal for FORTIA SYSTEMS. Text lines wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, with y: '100%' animating to y: '0%'.
motion.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling via Lenis is MANDATORY.
motion.micro_interactions: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with border glowing on hover. Buttons have sharp scale/bg transitions.

Hero.structure: Kinetic typography. Large H1 split into lines. Subtitle in JetBrains Mono. One abstract 3D/high-end tech image in the background with bg-black/50 overlay. Heavy bottom padding.

Portfolio_Grid.structure: 8 brands. Bento-style grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 or 4). Each card has an image (grayscale on default, color on hover), domain label in mono, title, description, and headline metric in large bold text.

Manifesto.structure: Numbered chapters. Huge numbers (01, 02) in JetBrains Mono outlining company philosophy. Staggered reveal on scroll via framer-motion.

Aggregate_Stats.structure: Large typographic numbers summing metrics across the portfolio. Use border separators between stats.

Marquee.structure: Slow scrolling text (Editorial Ribbon). Large text in Outline (text-transparent border-white stroke). High-energy tech phrases.

Contact_Form.structure: Sharp, border-based form inputs using Shadcn. Minimalist brutalist aesthetic. Clear focus states (ring-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML-based components for complex interactions. Use Shadcn for Form, Input, Textarea.
Create the Hero section with a strict framer-motion line-by-line masked text reveal for 'FORTIA SYSTEMS'.
Ensure 'lenis' is installed and wrapped around the app or main layout for smooth momentum scrolling.
Implement the Brands grid as a highly structured Bento layout, avoiding standard uniform squares.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive/key elements (e.g., data-testid='contact-form-submit-button').
Never use pure black or gray; stick to the defined base/surface colors.
Add 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial ticker section.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for UI elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (like headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or text for images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
